description: This PHP source file defines the Page class within the Api\V8\Param\Options namespace. The class extends a base option class and is responsible for adding 'page' parameter validation and normalization logic to an OptionsResolver. It sets constraints on the 'page' parameter, ensuring it is an array, not blank, and matches a pattern to exclude digits, then normalizes it into a PageParams object.
